pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Pages" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Numbers" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Numbers" to activate' && sleep 5 && osascript -e 'tell application "Numbers" to tell (make new document with properties {document template:template "Blank"}) to tell table 1 of sheet 1 to set {column count, row count, header row count, header column count} to {2, 4, 0, 0}'
instruction: Name the current table with title "GDP (PPP)". Click elsewhere or press enter to make sure the change is stored.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "Numbers" to tell table 1 of sheet 1 of document 1 to return name' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "GDP (PPP)" && echo "True" || echo "False"
